item.title: Jordan Sentences 3 to Death Over Greek Orthodox Church Attack
item.description: A Jordanian court on Sunday sentenced three men to death by hanging over a deadly church shooting, as the kingdom’s Christmas celebrations were cancelled in solidarity with the victims’ families. Gunmen killed nine people and wounded 25 others when they stormed a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in southern Hammoud village, Karak governorate, on October 23. Authorities said three men, two Jordanian brothers and their relative by marriage, had fled after the attack and were arrested three days... Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English, South China Morning Post, The Hindu - International. Fuente: The New York Times - World.

item.title: Alabama court upholds mother's sole custody after harassment, but orders new visitation schedule
item.description: After sending threatening emails to his ex-wife, an Alabama father grappled with custody issues. The court granted sole custody to the mother, citing the father's harassment. Although the appeals court upheld this decision, they recognized that the father's visitation hours were excessively limited. Consequently, a reassessment of the visitation schedule was ordered, while a protection order against him remains active until March 2027. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Georgia woman wins $2.5m after rear-end crash leads to spinal fusion surgery
item.description: A woman from Georgia received a substantial $2.5 million settlement for severe neck injuries resulting from a car accident in 2023. The incident occurred when her vehicle was rear-ended while awaiting at a traffic light. Following the crash, she underwent significant medical interventions, including spinal surgery. Her legal team emphasized how these injuries drastically altered her quality of life, highlighting the profound consequences of personal injuries. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: An Australian railway enthusiast spent 13 years building a mini version of a 315-kilometre route

Initially designed to be portable, the project has since transitioned into a permanent display rich in detail, reflecting Michalak's family history and personal ties to the railway. Efforts are ongoing to enhance this intricate layout over the next decade. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
